heading: How do I process a mixed batch of files?
introduction: Add supported images, GIFs, video, audio, PDFs or ZIPs to one queue. FileCompresser identifies each file and runs the appropriate workflow on your device. ZIP inputs are extracted rather than compressed again.

sections.heading: Choose one queue or a specialist tool
sections.body: Use this page when you have several supported file types to process. Choose a dedicated tool below when you need controls such as an image output format, video resolution or MP3 bitrate.

sections.heading: Review each result separately
sections.body: Review the controls available for your selection, start processing, then compare each input and output. Ordinary compression retains the original unchanged when a candidate is not smaller. Explicit conversions, resizing and ZIP creation are separate operations and may increase bytes; extraction is not a compression saving.

sections.heading: What this queue can accept
sections.body: Supported formats and per-file limits appear in the upload area. Queues accept up to 500 files and 300 MB in total. Files with unsupported signatures are rejected, even if their extensions look familiar.

links.label: What local processing means for privacy

seoTitle: Compress Any File Online Free Without Uploading
seoDescription: Compress files online for free, including images, videos, audio, PDFs and ZIP files. Process multiple file types privately in your browser.
